description: Only films with a replacement cost above 20.99 are included. A cost of exactly 20.99 is left out.

a.request: Among films whose replacement cost is more than 20.99, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded).
a.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio AS average, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_overall_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean

b.request: Considering only films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 (excluding exactly 20.99), compute per rating the average of rental_rate/rental_duration (ignoring NULLs), take the simple mean of those per-rating averages, and list each rating whose average is strictly above that overall mean, showing the rating, its average, and its unrounded difference from the overall mean.
b.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio AS average, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS difference FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating
b.raw: Considering only films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 (excluding exactly 20.99), compute per rating the average of rental_rate/rental_duration (ignoring NULLs), take the simple mean of those per-rating averages, and list each rating whose average is strictly above that overall mean, showing the rating, its average, and its unrounded difference from the overall mean.

c.request: Using 20.99 as the replacement-cost cutoff for films, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` over the qualifying films (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded). Only films with a replacement cost above 20.99 are included. A cost of exactly 20.99 is left out.
c.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio AS avg_rate_per_day, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_overall FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean

d.request: Using only films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 (exactly 20.99 excluded), compute for each rating the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration (ignoring NULLs), take the simple mean of those per-rating averages, and list each rating whose average is strictly above that mean, showing the rating, its average, and its unrounded difference from the overall mean.
d.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio AS average, p.avg_ratio - o.mean_avg AS difference_from_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.mean_avg ORDER BY p.avg_ratio DESC
